subject: NovaCorp POC: stakeholder map, procurement path & activation next steps

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: NovaCorp discovery recap — proposed POC success criteria + owners

Thanks for the time this morning, Jared/Priya — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align owners and timelines before we spin up the trial environment.

Summary of what we heard (short):
- Goal: validate 1) latency under a live-traffic-style workload (avg token latency < 250ms for chat paths) and 2) integration compatibility with Nova's query pipeline (embedding + rerank)
- Success criteria (proposed):
  - Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 300ms for 1–2 user concurrency (representative queries)
  - Functional: end-to-end embedding -> rerank accuracy within 5% of baseline on the provided eval set
  - Cost: demonstration of unit-cost reduction relative to their current endpoint (benchmarked by tokens/embedding)

Immediate asks / decisions we need from both sides:
1) Confirm internal ownership for infra, app integration, security sign-off, and procurement on Nova's side (names & email).
2) Redwood owners below — please confirm availability: Marcus Lin (infra / environment lead), Marissa Cole (customer success / evaluation lead), Aditya Rao (security handoff / SOC2 + dataflow review), Rishi Malhotra (commercial / procurement lead).
3) Timeline: propose kickoff week of 11/24 with a 3-week trial window. Procurement needs to be OK’d by 11/30 to keep that schedule.

Attachments: NovaCorp_POC_RACI.xlsx (draft), NovaCorp_POC_SOW-draft.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf

Next steps I’ll take: upload a shared RACI and SOW draft to the Drive and schedule an initial kickoff once owners are confirmed.

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0190

Thanks Kimberly — great summary. Quick answers from our side on owners and priorities so you can map RACI: 

- Infra owner: TJ Miller (tj.miller@novacorp.com) — will coordinate access to test cluster and cloud accounts.
- App/integration owner: Priya Shah (pshah@novacorp.com) — owns the query pipeline and will provide a sample CI job for end-to-end tests.
- Security reviewer: Julian Park (j.park@novacorp.com) — will need the SOC2 summary and a dataflow diagram.

We’re aligned on the 3-week window; if procurement slips past 11/30 we’ll need to shift kickoff but we’ll do our best to meet that date.

- Marissa will own quality gating and will request a small baseline prompt set from Priya to measure rerank delta.
